name: Friendswood
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Friendswood, TX 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Friendswood, TX: Santa in the Park at Stevenson Park on December 12, 2026, run by the city's Parks and Recreation Department.
lede: Friendswood keeps its Christmas in one place, Stevenson Park, where the city's Parks and Recreation Department holds Santa in the Park each December.
celebrates: The City of Friendswood puts its biggest holiday night at Stevenson Park, 1100 S. Friendswood Drive. The Parks and Recreation Department runs Santa in the Park, and its event page invites families to come experience the hometown magic of Christmas there. The city's event calendar lists the date, time and the Santa in the Park page for details, and its Instagram post says the evening is free, with no wristbands and no tickets. Because the city publishes the event on its own calendar, families can check the date and hours on the city's website before they go.
lastyear: In 2025, the Friendswood Parks and Recreation Department announced that Santa in the Park would return on Saturday, December 13, from 3 to 8 pm at Stevenson Park. The department's post said the evening would include the lighting of its 40-foot Christmas tree. The 2026 event keeps the same park, the same 3 to 8 pm hours and a Saturday in mid December. We did not find a local news recap of last year's turnout, so this page does not describe it.
facts: Friendswood's Santa in the Park runs five hours, from 3 pm to 8 pm, which lets families come in daylight and stay for the lights after dark. The city lists the event page under Recreation in Friendswood, in its Events section, and its calendar entry gives the date, the time and a link back to that page. The city's calendar also lists Christmas in September on September 11 and 12, 2026, from 9 am to 5 pm and 9 am to 4 pm, a sign of how early the city plans its season.
trains: Friendswood has no Christmas train event that we could confirm this year. The closest rail experience we found is The Polar Express train ride at the Galveston Railroad Museum, which our Galveston page already lists, and the kiddie train at Moody Gardens during Holiday in the Gardens. Families can also add a visit to the Galveston Railroad Museum or the Rosenberg Railroad Museum to a day out.

Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 3 to 8 pm at Stevenson Park, according to the city's event calendar.

Yes. The Friendswood Parks and Recreation Instagram post says free admission, with no wristbands and no tickets.
